done.title: The Woman Who Touched His Cloak

queue.title: The Rich Young Man
queue.idea: man runs and kneels / Jesus looks at him with love / he walks away sad, bag of coins

queue.title: The Great Catch
queue.idea: empty nets all night / casts again at his word, net bursts / they leave the boats and follow

queue.title: The Great Banquet
queue.idea: guests make excuses / the poor and lame brought in / table full

queue.title: The Faithful Servant
queue.idea: master leaves / one servant feeds the household / the other sleeps and the master returns

queue.title: The Two Debtors
queue.idea: two owe a lender / both forgiven / the one forgiven more loves more

queue.title: The Widow of Nain
queue.idea: funeral procession / Jesus says do not weep / the young man sits up and is given to his mother

queue.title: Mary Magdalene at the Tomb
queue.idea: weeping at the empty tomb / thinks he is the gardener / he says her name, she turns

queue.title: The Centurion's Faith
queue.idea: soldier: I am not worthy / Jesus marvels / servant healed at that hour

queue.title: Ruth's Loyalty
queue.idea: Orpah kisses and leaves / Ruth clings / they walk on together

queue.title: Daniel in the Lions' Den
queue.idea: prays at the open window / thrown to the lions / lions lie down (check CPDV numbering)

queue.title: The Burning Bush
queue.idea: shepherd sees the bush burning, not consumed / turns aside / removes his sandals

queue.title: Speak, Lord
queue.idea: boy wakes and runs to Eli / sent back to lie down / answers: speak, your servant hears (check CPDV book naming)

queue.title: Joseph Forgives His Brothers
queue.idea: brothers terrified / come closer to me / embrace

queue.title: Be Still
queue.idea: Vulgate numbering: Hebrew Psalm 46 is CPDV Psalm 45; busy man rushing / storm and mountains shaking / he stops, sits, is still

queue.title: Wings Like Eagles
queue.idea: runners collapse / young men fail / one who hopes rises, eagle above

queue.title: Pentecost
queue.idea: disciples hidden in a room / wind and tongues of fire / they go out to the crowd

queue.title: The Good Thief
queue.idea: three crosses / one mocks, one asks / 'today you will be with me in Paradise' light

queue.title: Faithful in Little
queue.idea: a man faithful with a coin / careless with a coin / trusted with more

queue.title: The Pearl of Great Price
queue.idea: three merchants find the same pearl / one keeps bargaining, one shrugs and walks on / one sells everything and buys it (pearl prop)

queue.title: Doers of the Word
queue.idea: three people read the same scroll / one closes it and walks away, one looks in a mirror and forgets / one gets up and helps a neighbour

queue.title: The Widow of Zarephath
queue.idea: last handful of flour / she bakes for Elijah first / the jar of flour never runs out

queue.title: The Sheep and the Goats
queue.idea: three people pass a hungry stranger, a sick man, a prisoner: two walk past / one stops for each, and the stranger is a robed silhouette in light

numbering: Two videos per day: dayNNa and dayNNb (NN = day number, two digits). Next run makes the day after the last done[].day.
